headline: SPACE PROBE READY FOR FLIGHT TO OUTER PLANETS
dispatch: Cape Canaveral, Fla., Sept. 6. NASA yesterday sent Voyager 1 aloft from Launch Complex 41 aboard a Titan-Centaur rocket. The unmanned craft is bound for close observations of Jupiter and Saturn before continuing into deep space.
answer: Voyager 1 begins its journey beyond the planets, 1977
